messages:
Priya (Marketing): Quick brainstorm: run a 20-30min community refapp sprint next Thursday. Deliverables: a short hands-on tutorial, a tiny benchmark appendix, and a gated "starter kit" for signups. Low friction. Who can take which pieces?
Leo (DevRel): I can scaffold the repo and the step-by-step tutorial notebook. CLI dev flow + minimal frontend to demo a real UX is ideal.
Ravi (Eng): I'll do a small perf sweep (cold vs warm cache) and a Hosted vs Dedicated cost sketch. Keep charts to 2-3 so copy stays tight.
Tasha (Growth): For registration copy, two options: "Build a production-ready LLM UX in 20 minutes" or "From prototype to predictable inference". Which reads more community-friendly?
Marta (Design): I'll mock up a landing variant and a GIF hero showing the local dev loop. Need 3 screenshots from Leo by Tue evening.
Priya (Marketing): Suggested webinar format: 3m intro, 10m live build walkthrough, 5m benchmark highlights, 7-10m Q&A. Leo, can you own run-of-show?
Leo (DevRel): Yep. I'll include a deterministic demo script and a short checklist in the repo README. Proposed run-of-show attached to repo as /run_of_show.md.
Ravi (Eng): For reproducibility, include this command in appendix:

```bash
# reproducible perf sample
python perf/sample_bench.py --model redwood-small --seq 256 --batch 2 --warmup 20 --client-version 0.12.1
```

Ravi (Eng): I'll record GPU (A10G), quant flags, and exact SDK version so the numbers are reproducible.
Tasha (Growth): Channel plan: community newsletter, pinned OSS issue, Twitter thread, and Discord. Starter kit gated for commercial interest (short form: name, github, use case).
Priya (Marketing): Good. Also create UTM variants per channel and a short drip sequence: immediate download email + 2 follow-ups (tips + case study).
Marta (Design): Social assets: 60s highlight clip, 30s GIF for tweets, and a 15s snippet for Discord. I'll need the recorded session trimmed.
OpsBot: Heads-up: demo namespace available Thu 3-5pm; request booking by Wed EOD. Recording enabled on request.
Leo (DevRel): I'll reserve Thu 3-4pm and run a dress rehearsal Wed. Repo tasks: setup, tutorial notebook, demo GIF, run_of_show.md.
Ravi (Eng): Deliverables: perf CSV, small script, 2 charts (latency p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens) by Wed noon.
Tasha (Growth): I'll draft registration page copy and an email template. Priya, can you review for tone?
Priya (Marketing): Yes. Action owners: Leo - repo + run-of-show + screenshots; Ravi - perf artifacts + appendix; Marta - assets; Tasha - landing + registration + UTMs; Priya - blog post + newsletter. Sync Friday to confirm assets. :rocket:
